title: Balochistan Provincial Motor Vehicles Second Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Provincial Motor Vehicles Second Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XVI OF 2001
ORDINANCE XVI OF 2001
PROVINCIAL MOTOR
VEHICLES
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further
to amend the Provincial Motor
Vehicles Ordinance,
1965
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
3rd August, 2001]
No.Legis.4‑23/Law/71, dated
3‑8‑2001.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the Governor
of Balochistan on 31st July, 2001, is hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement. ‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Provincial Motor Vehicles (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to
have taken effect on 23rd day of April, 2001.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 25 of Ordinance XIX of 1965

ORDINANCE XVI OF 2001
ORDINANCE XVI OF 2001
PROVINCIAL MOTOR
VEHICLES
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further
to amend the Provincial Motor
Vehicles Ordinance,
1965
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
3rd August, 2001]
No.Legis.4‑23/Law/71, dated
3‑8‑2001.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the Governor
of Balochistan on 31st July, 2001, is hereby published for general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 25 of
Ordinance XIX of 1965.-----In the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance,
1965, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance., in section 25‑‑
(x) in subsection (1) for the
existing Form "F", the new Form "F" appended to this
Ordinance, shall be substituted.
(b) for subsection (2), the
following shall be substituted:‑‑
"(2) The
Registering Authority shall issue to the owner of a Motor Vehicle registered by
it a certificate of registration in Form G, appended to this Ordinance and
shall enter in the Register in Form G‑I, appended to this Ordinance, to
be kept by it particulars of such certificate."
